name: cloudflare_list_dns_records
description: List DNS records in a zone. Returns an array of {id, type, name, content, ttl, proxied, ...}; each record's `id` is the `record_id` needed to get, update, patch, or delete it. Requires `zone_id` (from cloudflare_list_zones). Optional `type` (e.g. 'A', 'CNAME', 'TXT', 'MX') and `name` (full record name, e.g. 'www.example.com') to filter, and `per_page` (default 100, max 100).

zone_id.description: The zone id whose records to list (from cloudflare_list_zones).

name.description: Optional exact record name filter, e.g. 'www.example.com'.
